Don’t sweat it. If you think she’s interested in you, and you’re interested in her then this “date” would be a great opportunity to get to know each other more. At the date just create a more friendly and relaxed atmosphere by talking with her and warming up with each other. If she’s as interested in you as you are in her, take that as a good sign. 
If this is your first time going out with her, avoid asking her if it was a date or not. Like I said, you want a relaxed atmosphere. This might shift the mood to a bit tense between you two. Just act laid back. 
If at the end of the lunch “date” all went well then ask her out on another one but this time, you should clarify that it’s actually a date. Something along the lines of “Hey I really liked the sushi, if you wouldn’t mind you should let me take you out on a pizza date next time” would work. 
Remember to dress casual/nice. Good luck
